constraints.name: payment_request_extraordinary_revoke_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'active'::text AND revoked_by IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND revoke_reason IS NULL OR status = 'revoked'::text AND revoked_by IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(revoke_reason), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: payment_request_extraordinary_active_uidx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_request_extraordinary_active_uidx ON public.payment_request_extraordinary_authorizations USING btree (payment_request_id) WHERE (status = 'active'::text)

indexes.name: payment_request_extraordinary_authorizations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_request_extraordinary_authorizations_pkey ON public.payment_request_extraordinary_authorizations USING btree (id)

indexes.name: payment_request_extraordinary_request_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX payment_request_extraordinary_request_idx ON public.payment_request_extraordinary_authorizations USING btree (payment_request_id, created_at DESC)

triggers.name: enqueue_extraordinary_payment_notification
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER enqueue_extraordinary_payment_notification AFTER INSERT ON payment_request_extraordinary_authorizations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enqueue_extraordinary_payment_notification()

triggers.name: materialize_extraordinary_payable_snapshot
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER materialize_extraordinary_payable_snapshot AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON payment_request_extraordinary_authorizations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION materialize_extraordinary_payable_snapshot()

triggers.name: set_payment_request_extraordinary_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER set_payment_request_extraordinary_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_request_extraordinary_authorizations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_batch_execution_updated_at()
